title: P2 grant and ungrant: request
description: Membership of a principal in a group with a deadline, and its removal. Ordinary groups are granted by an admin with admin:people (farmctl or /grant in a direct chat), groups from delegated_groups also by them (PRM-16); privileged ones only by the operator through farmctl with a verification code, on a production tenant on the written request of another person (PRM-13). One can grant only what one has oneself (PRM-7). Removal cancels pending approvals (APR-6).

code.description: Verification code that the operator checked by voice or in person (--code); stored only as a hash.

requested_by.description: Admin of the production tenant, another person (--requested-by).
